high_level_description: This image captures a person taking a selfie on a busy street. The individual is wearing a black cap with white lettering, sunglasses, and a white face mask. They are dressed in a black T-shirt featuring a colorful, circular design with concentric patterns in blue, green, yellow, and red. The setting appears to be an urban area with a mix of natural and man-made elements. There are trees lining the street, providing some shade. The street itself has multiple lanes, with vehicles including a yellow auto-rickshaw and a red truck visible in the background.
